name: coh
description: CoH (Code of Harness) routes coding agents through repository-owned guidance and collects bounded, report-only validation evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and route repository harness work
interface.longDescription: Use three explicit CoH Skills to assess, build, and check a repository harness, with opt-in task routing and report-only validation receipt collection. Repository files remain the authority, and lifecycle hooks never edit Guide, Fact Map, AGENTS.md, tests, or CI.
capabilities: Assess repository harness needs without writes
Build an approved repository Harness Model
Route opted-in tasks to repository-owned guidance
defaultPrompt: Use $coh:set-up to assess this repository without changing it.
Use $coh:build <plan_sha256> in the same Task to construct the approved repository harness.
Use $coh:check to validate the existing repository harness.
